title: ADR 0001: Single-node scope, ~8 GB corpus, pure-Go zero-dependency default
summary: Scopes moedex to a single node, internal-first trust model, ~8 GB corpus envelope, and pure-Go default build; a 2026-08-25 amendment supersedes the zero-required-dependency clause for the MCP surface, which now requires the MCP go-sdk in the untagged build while single-node scope, corpus envelope, trust model, and optional dense/SIMD arms stand unchanged.
